# East Texas Events

> A curated calendar of events in East Texas, centred on Longview, Kilgore and the area around
> Shallow Creek RV Park. Every listed event was checked against its official source before
> publication.

This file is a placeholder published with the first deployment. The event sync job replaces it
with a generated version that lists the current feeds and their fields.

## Where to read events

- Calendar (HTML, with schema.org Event data on each event page): /calendar
- iCalendar feed of upcoming events: /calendar/feed/ical
- RSS feed of upcoming events: /calendar/feed/rss
- JSON feed with source and verification details: /events.json

## Notes

- All times are America/Chicago. Prices are in USD.
- The site runs on Event Schedule (https://eventschedule.com), self-hosted.
